data.description: A functional radio broadcast facility equipped with old consoles, a battered mixer, emergency power systems, and a skylight. The studio contains broadcasting equipment including an ON AIR sign, microphone, cassette cue system, and tape reels. Windows are present and subject to weather exposure.
data.name: Community Radio Studio
data.narrative_significance: The Community Radio Studio serves as the operational hub for emergency broadcast communications during a crisis event. It functions as a lifeline for the community, coordinating information about road closures, shelter locations, and missing persons. The studio represents resilience and community coordination, operating under emergency power conditions and serving as a gathering place for coordinated relief efforts.
